about: Loudness targets and edit settings for podcast-edit. Every number was written from memory or chosen by the builder on the date shown; none was read in a standard or a platform's documentation, so every entry says verified false.

podcast.about: Spoken word for podcast apps, stereo file

loudness.source: a level podcast apps are often said to ask for, written from memory; not read in any platform's documentation during this work

max_true_peak.source: a common delivery ceiling, written from memory; not read in a standard during this work

podcast-mono.about: Spoken word for podcast apps, mono file

loudness.source: the mono counterpart often quoted beside the stereo level, written from memory; not read in any platform's documentation during this work

max_true_peak.source: a common delivery ceiling, written from memory; not read in a standard during this work

loudness.source: the EBU R 128 programme level as remembered; the recommendation itself was not read during this work

max_true_peak.source: the EBU R 128 ceiling as remembered; the recommendation itself was not read during this work

loudness_tolerance.source: mstack default chosen by the builder

max_silence.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: a pause longer than this is shortened

keep_silence.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: how much of a long pause is left

silence_noise_db.source: mstack default chosen by the builder; a noisy room needs a higher value

crossfade.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: the overlap at every join

filler_pad.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: extra time removed each side of a filler word

duration_tolerance.source: mstack default chosen by the builder: lossy encoders pad a file by a few hundredths of a second
